description: Optimize an already succeeded generated model, or final models inside an asset pack, into a lighter GLB. This is derivative post-processing on existing assets, not a new creation request. Use when the user asks to optimize, compress, reduce file size, or prepare for web/runtime use. Retrieve optimized files through get_asset_artifact_manifest for code-project imports, or list_asset_artifacts/get_asset_artifact for one selected file after completion.
name: optimize_generated_model
